units.source_text: 在丹后由良站候车的时候，阵雨袭来，没有顶棚的车站顿时全被淋湿了。

en.t: While I was waiting for the train at Tango-Yura Station, a shower came on, and the roofless station was instantly drenched.

units.source_text: 着便服的警官陪伴我走进车站办公室。

en.t: The plainclothes policeman accompanied me into the station office.

units.source_text: 他蛮自豪地向我显示，站长和站务员都是他的朋友。

en.t: With considerable pride, he made it clear to me that the stationmaster and the station staff were all friends of his.

units.source_text: 不仅如此，他还向大家介绍我是他的侄子，从京都来的。

en.t: Not only that, he also introduced me to everyone as his nephew, who had come from Kyoto.
